description: SPEND AUTHORIZATION (Skyfire Programmable Payment): create a charge AND check it against what the agent's OWNER signed off — token, recipient allow-list, per-charge max, AND the cumulative cap. Fail-closed and drain-safe: an EIP-681 payment intent is issued ONLY if the charge is authorized (ten small charges cannot beat a low cap). BIII does not verify the authorization JWT signature itself — pass verified:true after checking it, or supply a spendAuth object. The caller tracks spentMicro (BIII is stateless).

spendAuth.description: the owner's signed spend authorization: a Programmable-Payment JWT (string) OR an object {token, chainId, maxPerChargeMicro, cumulativeCapMicro, allowedRecipients, exp}

spentMicro.description: how much has ALREADY been spent under this authorization (the caller's running total — the cumulative guard)

verified.description: attest the authorization JWT signature verified (BIII does not check it itself)

name: till_authorize
